data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 76afc4df3a5d7024e4a7c5dd00de782aebdbf228
* **workflow:** .github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The `Upload review artifact` step (.github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml lines 45-51) should upload the diff and findings under a valid artifact name. The current name template `sprint-story-review-${{ github.ref_name }}` evaluates to `sprint-story-review-story/<epic-id>/<story-id>` on story branches. GitHub Actions artifact names cannot contain forward slashes.

#### Actual Behavior

Run 25745496742 (push to story/f61f-7e0a/validation-artificial) emitted:

```
##[error]The artifact name is not valid: sprint-story-review-story/f61f-7e0a/validation-artificial. Contains the following character:  Forward slash /
```

The artifact upload fails on every story/<epic-id>/<story-id> branch (every real DSO sprint per-story branch). The same name template appears twice in the workflow (upload and prior-review download steps).

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Workflow: .github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml lines 35 (download) and 49 (upload)
* Fix sketch: substitute slashes (e.g. `${{ github.ref_name }}` -> a sanitized variant with `-` instead of `/`)
* Caller epic: f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d DD2 Proxy C.
data.title: [sprint-story-review.yml]: Upload review artifact step -> rejected because artifact name contains forward slash
